note: PROVISIONAL. Chosen by Claude to render a first pass under RFC 0025, not by the author. The setting (place, date, year), the art direction and every alt line below are the author's to change; the game's own text fixes none of them.

setting.place: Cape Ferrin is fictional. Rendered as a high-Arctic island at 78.0 N, 14.0 E, UTC+1.
why: The polar dark with 'twenty days until a plane can land' and 'light enough on the strip: the twentieth day' (state.py): at 78 N the noon sun is about 9.9 degrees below the horizon on 10 January and about 6.0 degrees below on 29 January.

Strata's sky blends from night to day between about -6.9 and +14.5 degrees of sun elevation (src/render/sun.cpp), so day 1 renders as full night at every watch and day 20 is the first day the noon sky would start to show twilight.
The watches are 08:00, 14:00 and 20:00 ('it is dark for all of them').
The dark flight in the story is 'the first dark flight in fifty years' after 1971 (endings.py), hence 2021.

artDirection: Flat-coloured Strata primitives, no textures; one still per location; no people drawn (the characters are written, not drawn - RFC 0025 non-goal).

galley.alt: The galley at night: a table laid with plates under a hanging lamp, the iron stove glowing orange against the back wall, a shelf of tins, the flour bin, crates stacked by the store door, and a black window.

office.alt: Marit's office: the station log open on the desk under a lamp, the barograph in its glass case beside it, dials on the wall, a filing cabinet, and a shelf of old log books.

radio.alt: The radio room: grey cabinets of the set with its valves glowing on top, a Morse key and an open log-book on the bench, and a chessboard with a game in progress on a small table.

shed.alt: The generator shed under one bare bulb: the green diesel on its plinth, the red day-tank on a stand, the snowmobile under a tarpaulin with its skis showing, and a sledge with iron runners.

bunks.alt: The bunkroom: two pairs of bunks, a small stove glowing in the corner, lockers, and a reading lamp left burning on the lower left bunk.

strip.alt: The strip in the polar dark: gravel under snow running away into the night, a striped windsock straight out on its mast, red huts with lit windows, and the dark line of the ridge behind.

hut.alt: The old log hut across the bay: a stove going with a kettle on it, a lamp lit on the table beside a book, two bunks, and four crates stacked under the window.
